scene.topic_description:
Situation: At passport control, the learner speaks to a border officer before entering or leaving through the border point. It is the learner's first time flying to London, and this is the interaction they are most worried about because they must answer clearly and stay calm.
Learner: Traveller. Partner: Border officer.
Not in this scene: check-in, baggage questions, security screening, finding the gate, transport in the city.
must_say: give your passport — slot: the document
answer where you are going — slot: the destination
answer why you are travelling — slot: the reason
answer how long you will stay — slot: the length of stay
answer where you will stay — slot: the place
ask whether everything is okay — slot: none
confirm you understand where to go next — slot: the place
must_understand: asks where you are travelling to
asks the purpose of your trip
asks how long you will stay and where you will stay
says you can go through or tells you where to go next

findings.detail: the right option «The purpose of the journey» repeats «the purpose» of A's «What is the purpose of your trip?»
«reason» occurs in no frame and no partner line
the line names «the exit», a filler of p7
«go to» is a word of the stop list («go»)
the right option «El motivo del viaje» repeats «el motivo» of A's «¿Cuál es el motivo de su viaje?»

topic.description_target: Answer basic questions at passport control, give your passport, and confirm what to do next.
topic.description_native: Responder preguntas básicas en el control de pasaportes, entregar el pasaporte y confirmar qué hacer después.

check.text_target: What document does the officer request?
check.explanation_native: El agente pide ver el documento de viaje del viajero.

check.text_target: What destination does the officer want to know?
check.explanation_native: El agente quiere saber cuál es el destino del viajero.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: What is the purpose of your trip?
messages.text_native: ¿Cuál es el motivo de su viaje?

check.text_target: What reason for the journey does the officer ask about?
check.text_native: ¿Qué motivo del viaje pregunta el agente?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta por la razón del viaje.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I will stay for two weeks.
messages.pronunciation_native: ai uil stei for tu uíks

check.text_target: What length of time does the officer ask about?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta cuánto durará la estancia.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I will stay at a hotel.
messages.pronunciation_native: ai uil stei at a joutél

check.text_target: What place of accommodation does the officer ask about?
check.text_native: ¿Qué lugar de alojamiento pregunta el agente?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta dónde se alojará el viajero.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Everything is fine. You can go through now.
messages.text_native: Sí, todo está bien. Puede pasar ahora.

check.text_target: What does the officer say the traveller can do now?
check.text_native: ¿Qué dice el agente que puede hacer ahora el viajero?
check.explanation_native: El agente dice que puede pasar ahora.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Everything is fine. Go through now.

check.text_target: Does the officer say there is a problem?
check.text_native: ¿Dice el agente que hay algún problema?
check.explanation_native: El agente repite que todo está bien, así que no hay ningún problema.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I go to the exit now, right?
messages.pronunciation_native: ai gou tu di éksit nau rait
simplified_variants: I go to the exit now.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Sí, siga las señales, por favor.

check.text_target: What instruction does the officer give?
check.explanation_native: El agente indica que debe seguir las señales.

questions.explanation_native: El viajero dice que va a Londres.
El viajero dice que viaja por turismo.

questions.text_native: ¿Qué confirma el agente al final del control?
questions.explanation_native: El agente confirma que todo está bien y que puede pasar ahora.

check.text_target: What document does the officer request?
check.explanation_native: El agente pide ver el documento de viaje del viajero.

check.text_target: What destination does the officer want to know?
check.explanation_native: El agente quiere saber cuál es el destino del viajero.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: What is the purpose of your trip?
messages.text_native: ¿Cuál es el motivo de su viaje?

check.text_target: What reason for the journey does the officer ask about?
check.text_native: ¿Qué motivo del viaje pregunta el agente?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta por el motivo del viaje.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I will stay for two weeks
messages.pronunciation_native: ai uil stei for tu uíks

check.text_target: What length of time does the officer ask about?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta cuánto durará la estancia.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I will stay at a hotel
messages.pronunciation_native: ai uil stei at a joutél

check.text_target: What place of accommodation does the officer ask about?
check.text_native: ¿Qué lugar de alojamiento pregunta el agente?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta dónde se alojará el viajero.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Everything is fine. You can go through now.
messages.text_native: Sí, todo está bien. Puede pasar ahora.

check.text_target: What does the officer say the traveller can do now?
check.text_native: ¿Qué dice el agente que puede hacer ahora el viajero?
check.explanation_native: El agente dice que puede pasar ahora.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Everything is fine. Go through now.

check.text_target: Does the officer say there is a problem?
check.text_native: ¿Dice el agente que hay algún problema?
check.explanation_native: El agente repite que todo está bien, así que no hay ningún problema.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I go to the exit now, right?
messages.pronunciation_native: ai gou tu di éksit nau rait
simplified_variants: I go to the exit now.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Sí, siga las señales, por favor.

check.text_target: What instruction does the officer give?
check.explanation_native: El agente indica que debe seguir las señales.

questions.explanation_native: El viajero dice que va a Londres.
El viajero dice que viaja por turismo.

questions.text_native: ¿Qué confirma el agente al final del control?
questions.explanation_native: El agente confirma que todo está bien y que puede pasar ahora.
